items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: We had Edna Orman and we had, oh, John Hammond

ctx.x: And it was so great. We had Edna Orman and we had, oh, John Hammond, he came down here from New York, he was featured and he had big money at the same. They could play. I used to make a lot of extra money playing with him. I'd play solos. He wouldn't know what to do and they used to put him on for a feature number. So every once in a while he'd cash in on the fact that everybody liked me, or I think so anyhow, and I'd make a few bucks extra by playing a solo. Like East I might play the Hover City or something…
The name's familiar. He was at WWL.
